card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 108 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 21.9 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, WZ Sgr: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 108.5 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 1,620 parsecs away.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)

color.summary: The colour of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.
